purpose: PINN and DeepONet pricers for two-stock arithmetic basket options, each built as a ladder: every level adds one technique to the configuration below it, and every level is scored on the same validation contracts.
selection_rule: Within each family the level with the lowest validation score is selected. Score = mean over price and the ten Greeks of RMSE / RMS(reference) on the 4,096 validation contracts drawn from the protocol's training domain. A level within 1% of the best score yields to the earlier level.

computational_domain.note: Spatial extent of the PDE problem in z = log basket forward moneyness and s = first weight share, like a grid solver's far boundary. sigma_1, sigma_2, rho and the maturity cap are the protocol's training domain; tau starts at 0 because the PDE starts at the payoff.
